title: EEG: Probabilistic Selection Task (PST) + PST with Cabergoline Challenge
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from two studies using the Probabilistic Selection Task (PST) with healthy participants. Study 1 included 85 participants (80 main plus 5 placebo pilot sessions), while Study 2 was a double-blind, placebo-controlled trial testing the effects of the dopamine agonist Cabergoline (1.25 mg) on task performance in 27 participants across two sessions. The data were collected circa 2012-2013 at the Laboratory for Neural Computation & Cognition at Brown University and are related to a published study examining cognitive control and reward learning.
methods_description: EEG data were collected while participants performed a Probabilistic Selection Task, implemented in MATLAB. In Study 2, a double-blind design was used to assess the effects of Cabergoline (1.25 mg) versus placebo across two sessions per participant.
